ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) reflectance across approximately 85% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted with low-intensity (black) pigmentation along the trailing edge and specific linear clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pigmentation is concentrated along the distal trailing edge boundary. Significant dark linear bands are mapped to the lateral-distal regions of both lobes, specifically centered in the outer thirds of the fluke width.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern visible across the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitudes varying between 3 and 12 pixels relative to the smooth lobe baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the medial region and extending to the acute distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Five distinct, roughly vertical parallel dark linear tracks on the distal-left lobe; three curvilinear parallel dark tracks on the distal-right lobe, corresponding to tooth rake patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring visible as low-intensity linear tracks across the high-intensity ventral background of both lobes.
